Several hours (gathering the 100 essences and the fingers depends on luck; the troll and imp tasks last at most 10 min each)

{npc:Fernlor}, High Scryer of the Arcane Academy (in the Noodles Academy in Edron), has detected a disturbance on a forgotten island to the east and set up a teleport to it: it is {wiki:Azzilon Castle|Azzilon}, a fortress taken over by the Inferniarchs. Help {npc:Lai} push back the deadly mist with {item:Demonic Core Essence|Demonic Core Essences}, free {npc:Ortelio}, sabotage the demons' operations in three team tasks and defeat the demon prince {creature:Arbaziloth}. You earn the base {wiki:Fiend Slayer Outfits|Fiend Slayer Outfit} and, if you beat the boss in hard mode, access to the {wiki:Doomforge|Doomforge}.
A magical disturbance has appeared on a remote island and threatens the balance of the world. Investigate the disturbance and fight the powerful Inferniarchs to uncover the truth.
Fernlor and the orange teleport (Noodles Academy, Edron, floor -1)

World change: the underground floors of Azzilon (the catacombs) are blocked by a mist until the players of your world hand in enough {item:Demonic Core Essence|Demonic Core Essences} to {npc:Lai}. When that happens, the server message *"The mists in Azzilon have retreated!"* appears. The exact amount is not known.
Team: from the troll task onwards, all tasks use a **lever for 5 players** and bringing as many players as possible is highly recommended. The final boss is also a team fight.
loot from the Azzilon Inferniarchs; can also be bought on the Market
the amount depends on luck; 10 to 20 are usually enough. Rare loot from the Inferniarchs or the Market
for the fishing task and, **one per player**, for the fight with Arbaziloth
Protection against **energy** (imp task) and against **death**, **energy** and **life drain** (fight with Arbaziloth)
Plenty of health potions: in the catacombs you take Agony Damage every 20 seconds
Base {wiki:Fiend Slayer Outfits|Fiend Slayer Outfit} (male and female)
Access to the {wiki:Doomforge|Doomforge} (only when you defeat {creature:Arbaziloth} on hard mode)
Lai's ranks: each rank reduces the Agony Damage in the catacombs; rank 5 (1,600 essences) gives access to the last floor of the catacombs
Achievement **Tear the Toxic Veil** (7 points) at rank 10 (51,200 essences handed in)

{creature:Arbaziloth} loot (500,000 experience): weapons from the {wiki:Inferniarch Set|Inferniarch Set} and {item:Demon Claws} on easy mode; {item:Demonfang Mask}, {item:Dreadfire Headpiece}, {item:Hellstalker Visor}, {item:Maliceforged Helmet}, {item:Demon Mengu}, {item:Demon Skull} and {item:Demon in a Green Box} (mount item) on hard mode
After **10 victories on hard mode**: an extra Doomforge room where you choose the base version of any Inferniarch Set weapon
Mission *To boldly go...*: after accepting {npc:Fernlor}'s mission, step into the orange teleport in the Noodles Academy, in Edron.
Mission *Evil to the core*: when you hand the first 100 {item:Demonic Core Essence|Demonic Core Essences} to {npc:Lai}.
They only open on your world after the mist recedes (world change: *"The mists in Azzilon have retreated!"*).
Last floor of the Azzilon catacombs
Use Demonic Core Essences without going back to Lai
After the first delivery of 100 essences: you can use the essences yourself to rank up.
When you report the mission to {npc:Lai} after defeating {creature:Arbaziloth} for the first time.
After beating {creature:Arbaziloth} in **hard mode** (sparing {creature:The Forgemaster (Creature)|The Forgemaster}), through the orange teleport in the boss room.
With 10 wins in hard mode an extra room opens where you choose a base Inferniarch Set weapon.
The addons ({item:Demon Claws} and {item:Demon Skull}) can only be used once you have the base outfit from this quest.

The {wiki:Agony Damage|Agony Damage} in the catacombs is **not** reduced by equipment or items: only {npc:Lai}'s ranks lower it. It is a percentage of your current HP and adds to the monsters' damage.
{item:Demonic Core Essence|Demonic Core Essences} and {item:Mummified Demon Finger|Mummified Demon Fingers} are stackable and sold on the **Market**: buying them saves many hours of hunting.
Always carry the {item:Fishing Rod} with you: you need it in the fishing task and in the fight with {creature:Arbaziloth}, and **every player** in the team should have their own.
Organise the team before starting the lever tasks (trolls, imps, fishing and boss): they are all for up to 5 players and become much harder with fewer people.
After each stage, go back to {npc:Lai} (south-east inner tower, floor +3) and say {key:mission}: she is always the one who gives out and receives the missions.
1. To boldly go... — from Edron to Azzilon
The quest starts with Fernlor, in the basement of one of the towers of the Noodles Academy, in Edron. From there a teleport takes you to the fortress island of Azzilon, where Lai is.
Take a boat to **Edron** from one of the main ports, for example with {npc:Captain Bluebear} in Thais: {key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes}. You arrive at Edron harbour, next to {npc:Captain Seahorse}.

From the harbour, walk **south-east** to the seven ivory towers in the **east** part of Edron: this is the {wiki:Noodles Academy of Modern Magic|Noodles Academy of Modern Magic}. {npc:Fernlor} is on the **underground floor (-1)**, next to an orange teleport.

Say {key:hi}, {key:mission} and {key:yes}. Fernlor needs someone to investigate an anomaly: he has found a recent disturbance on a remote, unknown island to the **east** and set up a teleport link to it.
Enter the **orange teleport** next to Fernlor. You arrive at {wiki:Azzilon Castle|Azzilon Castle}, on the island of {wiki:Azzilon|Azzilon}. This is how you get in every time you return to Azzilon.
Enter the castle and reach Lai's tower
Go down the stairs and up another flight of stairs to enter the castle. Inside, keep heading **north** until you reach the **south-east inner tower**.

There are already {creature:Broodrider Inferniarch|Broodrider}, {creature:Gorger Inferniarch|Gorger} and {creature:Sineater Inferniarch|Sineater Inferniarchs} on the castle surface: go in ready to fight.

Go up the tower to **floor +3**: {npc:Lai} is in the centre of that floor. Say {key:hi} and {key:mission}. She asks you to collect {item:Demonic Core Essence|Demonic Core Essences}, which she will use to push back the deadly mist in the catacombs and to give you some protection against the effects the mist leaves behind.

Kill the Azzilon Inferniarchs until you have **100** {item:Demonic Core Essence|Demonic Core Essences}. Before the first hand-in you can only hunt on the castle surface, where {creature:Broodrider Inferniarch|Broodrider}, {creature:Gorger Inferniarch|Gorger} and {creature:Sineater Inferniarch|Sineater Inferniarchs} roam. The essences are a *semi-rare* drop; you can also buy them on the Market.
Keep any {item:Mummified Demon Finger|Mummified Demon Fingers} that drop while you hunt: you will need them later on.
Hand the essences in to Lai

Go back to {npc:Lai} (south-east inner tower, floor +3) and say {key:essences}. She explains that the more essences you bring her, the more resistant you become to the demonic corruption. From now on you can **use the essences yourself** to rank up, without having to go back to Lai, and the catacombs are open to you.
Rank 1 against the corruption and access to the Azzilon catacombs

While you are on **any underground floor** of Azzilon you take corruption damage (Agony Damage) **every 20 seconds**, calculated from the HP you have at that moment. Example: at rank 1 with 10,000 HP you take 450 damage. Each rank lowers that damage:
Access to the last floor of the catacombs
Tear the Toxic Veil is a grade 3 achievement (7 points)
Rank 1 is enough for the quest. The following ranks are for hunting with less damage and for the achievement.
3. A ward winning — the tower crystals
Say {key:mission} to {npc:Lai}. She asks you to activate the **ancient crystals** in the castle towers.
Activate the crystal in the north-west tower
Go to the **north-west** tower of the castle and activate the ancient crystal there. It must be the **first** one: from then on the crystal starts losing energy.
Without wasting time, activate the crystals in the **north-east**, **south-east** and **south-west** towers, all **before** the north-west crystal runs out of energy.
If the north-west crystal goes out before you activate the other three, you have to start again from the north-west tower.
Plan the route between the towers before activating the first crystal and clear the monsters along the way.
4. A troubled soul and The key person — free Ortelio
Go back to {npc:Lai} and say {key:mission}. The poisonous mist is retreating and she has sensed a pure soul in great despair somewhere **down below**, in the catacombs.

The monsters on the lower floors are stronger: {creature:Hellhunter Inferniarch|Hellhunter}, {creature:Spellreaper Inferniarch|Spellreaper} and {creature:Brinebrute Inferniarch|Brinebrute Inferniarchs}. If the mist has not yet retreated on your world, you cannot go down.
Go down to floor -1 and head to the teleport
Go down the catacomb stairs to the hunting area on **floor -1** and walk **south-east** to the teleport. From here on you take Agony Damage every 20 seconds.

Enter the teleport and you will find {npc:Ortelio}, who immediately asks you to help him get {key:out} of the prison. Ask him how to {key:open} the cell: he says the key could be anywhere, but that he has seen a {item:Mummified Demon Finger} being used to open it, and suggests you look for some of those fingers.

Hunt the Inferniarchs in the area until you have several {item:Mummified Demon Finger|Mummified Demon Fingers}. They drop (as a rare drop) from {creature:Broodrider Inferniarch|Broodrider}, {creature:Gorger Inferniarch|Gorger}, {creature:Sineater Inferniarch|Sineater}, {creature:Hellhunter Inferniarch|Hellhunter}, {creature:Spellreaper Inferniarch|Spellreaper} and {creature:Brinebrute Inferniarch|Brinebrute Inferniarchs}. The number needed depends on luck, but **10 to 20** are usually enough. They can also be bought on the Market.
Use the fingers on the cell door
Use the {item:Mummified Demon Finger|Mummified Demon Fingers}, one at a time, on Ortelio's **cell door** until you are teleported into the cell.
Each finger breaks whether it works or not: bring spare fingers.

Leave Ortelio's cell the way you came in (the wiki does not describe the way out of the cell) and go back to floor -1. Go up the catacomb stairs to the castle and go to {npc:Lai} (south-east inner tower, floor +3). Say {key:mission}: she says there is much to learn from what Ortelio discovered about the Inferniarchs, and that she has synchronised with the resonances of the castle's past and is willing to share with you the vision of what she has learned.
Say {key:mission} to {npc:Lai} again and accept her offer ({key:yes}) to attune you to the *Essence of Azzilon*. You are teleported to a new room.
In the new room, say {key:hi} to {npc:A Vision of the Past}.
Enter the **portal to the south** of the room: it takes you back to {npc:Lai}.
6. Blast from the past and Feeding the trolls
From here on, all tasks use a lever for 5 players. Gather the team: going with as many players as possible is highly recommended.

Say {key:mission} to {npc:Lai}. Based on what Ortelio discovered, you have to disrupt the demons' operations, and the most effective way is to **free their slave trolls**. Go and meet {npc:Ortelio} on **floor -2** of the catacombs.

Go down the catacomb stairs to **floor -2**, where {npc:Ortelio} is waiting for you. From there, head **south-east** and enter the teleport. Pull the **lever** with the team (up to 5 players) to start the task.
The task lasts at most **600 seconds (10 minutes)**. The cooldown is about 10 to 12 minutes.
Use the **food dispenser** in the **south-west corner** of the room to take {item:Some Troll Food}.
The food weighs 85 oz: keep some capacity free.

Use the {item:Some Troll Food} on a **Hungry Slave Troll**. It turns into a **Fed Slave Troll** for a few seconds and starts walking **north**, but then gets hungry again. Feed it (and the others) again whenever they stop.
Bring 20 trolls to the green portal
Repeat the process until **20 trolls** reach the **green portal** in the **north** area of the room. The task is then complete.
Split the team: some players fetch food from the dispenser and others escort the trolls on their way north.

Leave the troll room the way you came in (the wiki does not describe the way out of the room), go up the catacomb stairs to the castle, go back to {npc:Lai} and say {key:mission} to receive the next mission.
Go down to **floor -2** again and head to the **north-east** part of the cave, where there is a portal. Pull the **lever** with the team (up to 5 players).
The task lasts at most **600 seconds (10 minutes)**; the cooldown is about 10 minutes. Bring protection against **energy**.

You have to kill **25** {creature:Charged Imp|Charged Imps} without letting the counter of the **Powercollector**, in the **middle of the room**, reach **25**. Each Charged Imp you kill counts 1 towards the task. Each Charged Imp that crosses the floor around the Powercollector disappears and adds 1 to its counter.
Charged Imps are immune to **energy** damage (0%) and use Strong Haste: attack them with another element or physical damage.
Kill the {creature:Imp Warden|Imp Wardens}: this increases the chance of new Charged Imps appearing.
Imp Wardens take more damage from **earth** (120%), **holy** (115%) and **energy** (115%).
Block the way to the Powercollector

Each Charged Imp that spawns heads **straight for the Powercollector**. You and your team have to cut it off: stand in its way, or have **two players** surrounded by Imp Wardens near the Powercollector, acting as a barrier. Kill the imps before they reach the floor around the Powercollector.
As the team kills Charged Imps and the counter goes up, more enemies appear and the task gets harder.

Once you have killed enough Charged Imps, leave the room the way you came in (the wiki does not describe the way out), go up the catacomb stairs to the castle, go back to {npc:Lai} and say {key:mission}.
8. Teach a man to fish... — fishing for Energy Spheres
Go down to **floor -2** and look for the teleport to the fishing task. Bring your {item:Fishing Rod}. As in the previous tasks, it uses a **lever** for up to 5 players: gather the team and pull it.
The wiki does not give the exact position of this teleport: look for it on floor -2, like the teleports for the troll (south-east) and imp (north-east) tasks.
Use the {item:Fishing Rod} to fish **25 Energy Spheres**. Each sphere caught adds 1 point to the team's total and the message *"GOT ONE!"* appears.
There are {creature:Worker Imp|Worker Imps} in the room. You do not need to kill them, but watch out for their attacks.
When you finish, leave the room the way you came in (the wiki does not describe the way out), go up the catacomb stairs to the castle, go back to {npc:Lai} and report on the {key:mission}.
The final boss. Before going in, decide with the team which mode you will fight in: the mode changes the loot and decides whether you get access to the Doomforge.
Gather the team. **Each player** brings a {item:Fishing Rod}. Equip protection against **death** and **energy**, and against **life drain** for the demons and the Forgemaster.
Don't forget the {item:Fishing Rod}! Without it you cannot make Arbaziloth vulnerable.

{creature:Arbaziloth} (360,000 HP) takes 100% **holy** and **earth** damage, 85% **fire**, 80% **ice** and **death** and only 70% **physical** damage. He cannot be paralysed, sees through invisibility, attacks in melee and can cause **Powerless**. Since 25 February 2025 he is no longer affected by Damage Reflection.

Go down to **floor -3** of the catacombs and use the **portal** to {creature:Arbaziloth}'s lair. Inside are Arbaziloth, two {creature:Overcharged Demon|Overcharged Demons} and {creature:The Forgemaster (Creature)|The Forgemaster}.
The Forgemaster is there so that the team can decide which fight it wants:
Kill {creature:The Forgemaster (Creature)|The Forgemaster} during the fight
Arbaziloth does not heal at the end; the Doomforge does **not** become accessible
Weapons from the {wiki:Inferniarch Set|Inferniarch Set} and {item:Demon Claws} (1st Fiend Slayer addon)
After the 4th mechanic the Forgemaster leaves, and Arbaziloth fully heals and becomes stronger

{item:Demonfang Mask}, {item:Dreadfire Headpiece}, {item:Hellstalker Visor}, {item:Maliceforged Helmet}, {item:Demon Mengu}, {item:Demon Skull} (2nd addon), {item:Demon in a Green Box} (mount) and access to the {wiki:Doomforge|Doomforge}

The two {creature:Overcharged Demon|Overcharged Demons} are summons that respawn whenever they die, and **each one you kill heals Arbaziloth**. Two common strategies: lure them far away across the room until they lose their target, or have a player who is **not** the main blocker hold them.
Don't kill the Overcharged Demons: you are only healing the boss.

Attack {creature:Arbaziloth}. At **four** points in the fight it shouts *"Open fire you fools!"* and becomes **invulnerable**: it still takes damage, but its health doesn't go down. The {creature:Imp Minion|Imp Minions} fire the slingshot and a **purple fire field** appears at a random spot in the room.
Keep an eye out for this message: while he is invulnerable, you are wasting supplies for nothing.
Pull the boss onto the purple fire
The blocker brings Arbaziloth onto the **purple fire field** and keeps him there until you hear *"CRAAAACK!"*.
Use the Fishing Rods on the boss

Right after the *"CRAAAACK!"*, **everyone** uses the {item:Fishing Rod} on Arbaziloth to make him vulnerable again. The boss can dodge (Dodge) a rod, so it is recommended that the whole team uses theirs. When it works, a hearts effect appears on the boss, everyone loses their target and he loses one of the energy spheres on his arm. What he says tells you which round you are in:
After each round you have to target the boss again.
If you chose easy mode, kill {creature:The Forgemaster (Creature)|The Forgemaster} during the fight. That way Arbaziloth **does not heal**: complete the four rounds of the mechanic and kill him.
If the Forgemaster dies, you do not get access to the Doomforge on that kill.

If you spared the Forgemaster, shortly after the **4th mechanic** she leaves the fight and Arbaziloth **fully heals**. There are no more mechanics: just attack him until he dies, but in this phase he deals **more damage**.
Save supplies for this phase: the boss is back at full HP and hits harder.

Open Arbaziloth's corpse (500,000 experience). Besides crystal and platinum coins, potions and gems, it can contain items such as {item:Giant Sword}, {item:Ice Rapier}, {item:Stone Skin Amulet}, {item:Devil Helmet}, {item:Demonrage Sword} or {item:Arbaziloth Shoulder Piece}, plus the special loot of the mode you chose (see the table above).

If you spared the Forgemaster, use the room's **orange teleport** to enter the {wiki:Doomforge|Doomforge}. There, {npc:The Forgemaster} trades a base weapon from the {wiki:Inferniarch Set|Inferniarch Set} plus various creature products for an upgraded version:

Base weapons with a tier **cannot** be used in the Doomforge (the upgraded versions can be given tiers as usual). Weapons that can be upgraded: Inferniarch Arbalest, Battleaxe, Blade, Bow, Claws, Flail, Greataxe, Rod, Slayer, Wand and Warhammer.
Report to Lai and receive the outfit

After defeating {creature:Arbaziloth}, leave the boss room (or the Doomforge) the way you came in — the wiki does not describe the way out —, go up the catacomb stairs to the castle and report on the {key:mission} to {npc:Lai} one last time. You receive the base {wiki:Fiend Slayer Outfits|Fiend Slayer Outfit}.
After the quest: addons and the extra Doomforge room

Both addons come from Arbaziloth himself: {item:Demon Claws} (easy mode) and {item:Demon Skull} (hard mode); see the {wiki:Fiend Slayer Outfits Quest|Fiend Slayer Outfits Quest} guide. If you kill the boss **10 times on hard mode**, you gain access to an extra {wiki:Doomforge|Doomforge} room where you can take the base version of any {wiki:Inferniarch Set|Inferniarch Set} weapon of your choice.

The wiki does not describe the way out of the boss room or the return from Azzilon to Edron. Go back the way you came: go up through the catacomb floors by the same stairs to the castle and return to the spot where {npc:Fernlor}'s teleport left you; the wiki does not say whether there is a return teleport there. If you cannot find a way out, a {item:Temple Teleport Scroll} takes you to your temple (it does not work in No-Logout zones or while you have a Logout Block or Protection Zone Block). In Edron, take the boat from {npc:Captain Seahorse} at the harbour to return to your city.
While you are on the underground floors you keep taking Agony Damage every 20 seconds: don't stand around down there on low health.
Optional. Three Inferniarch minibosses appear when you use 10 creature items on a Sacrificial Altar. The hides they drop are needed for the Doomforge recipes.
Use the 10 items on the **Sacrificial Altar** on the floor shown to summon each miniboss:

The summoning items are loot from the Inferniarchs: {item:Bloodstained Scythe} (Brinebrute), {item:Spellreaper Staff Totem} (Spellreaper) and {item:Hellhunter Eye} (Hellhunter). The hides are rare drops.

The quest depends on a world change: the Azzilon catacombs are closed off by a mist until the players of the world hand in enough essences to {npc:Lai}. When the mist retreats, the server message *"The mists in Azzilon have retreated!"* appears and the stairs are cleared.
The Agony Damage in the catacombs is applied every 20 seconds on any underground floor and is a percentage of your current HP; only Lai's ranks reduce it (0% at rank 10).
The team tasks (trolls and imps) last at most 10 minutes and have a cooldown of about 10 to 12 minutes.

{creature:Arbaziloth}'s loot table changes depending on the mode: the {item:Demon Claws} and the Inferniarch Set weapons only on easy mode; the {item:Demon Skull}, the helmets and the {item:Demon in a Green Box} only on hard mode.
{npc:Lai} also appears (as an optional step) in the {wiki:Mystery of the Valley Quest|Mystery of the Valley Quest}.
